source_scope: unambiguous ordinary-building roof; heritage self-ignition excluded
anchor_policy: declare a metric coordinate before simulation; otherwise freeze a vector-roof representative point; never reselect the anchor after changing the mesh or demolition plan
footprint_policy: nested disk intersected with unambiguous source roof; radius solved for prescribed square metres; save the polygon and content hash before meshing
insufficient_source_roof_area: reject the requested area; do not enlarge the roof or silently substitute a different source area
mesh_binding: split roof states at the ignition polygon boundary; ignite the enclosed pieces at t=0; do not ignite every component merely intersecting the polygon
heat_release_policy: inherit material growth, steady and decay curves; preserve prescribed fuel, water, peak HRR and chemical energy across meshes; no source forcing fitted to heritage outcomes
matched_plan_comparison: freeze source building, anchor, ignition polygon, time, weather, terrain, material parameters and horizon
freeze the same baseline refinement set and local-grid origin before applying either plan; include source, both heritage cores and the named intervention neighborhood
apply no-demolition and the single hand-specified plan to that same layout; retained component parameters and prescribed source budgets must agree
actual source roofs and heritage cores remain protected from demolition; unknown eligibility remains a blocking input for real demolition
compare the same retained unambiguous ordinary-building cohort; record planned demolition separately from ignition

acceptance.time_tolerance_definition: max(10 seconds, 5 percent of the smaller positive ignition time)
acceptance.note: engineering comparison gates, not a physical safety margin or field validation
